caption: A pan of water on a stove is at a boil, and the burner is turned off; the bubbling dies down and only faint steam remains.

sa.check: A pan of boiling water sits on a hob.
The bubbling is vigorous before the knob is turned.
The order is boiling, knob turned, bubbling eased.

pc.expect: The bubbling begins to ease after the knob is turned, and not before.
pc.fail: The bubbling eases before the knob is touched; or the knob is turned and the water churns as hard as before to the end of the clip; or the boil grows after the knob is turned off; or the churn stops before the hand reaches the knob.

pc.expect: The easing runs one way: the churn dies down and the water does not come back to a rolling boil with the burner off.
pc.fail: The water returns to a rolling boil with the burner off; or the bubbling eases and surges in turn; or the churn stops in a single frame with the surface instantly flat; or the steam thickens after the burner is off.

pc.expect: The remaining bubbles rise to the surface and the faint steam rises above the pan.
pc.fail: Bubbles sink from the surface downward; or the steam sinks over the rim and pools on the hob; or the steam pours downward from the pan; or bubbles hang still in the water.

pc.expect: The water settles as a liquid: the surface goes from churning to shifting to nearly flat and finds its level.
pc.fail: The surface holds its churned shape frozen in place; or the water stands in a heap above its level; or the water sets solid; or the surface keeps a fixed pattern of peaks after the churn has stopped.

pc.expect: One pan of water on one hob; the water stays in the pan.
pc.fail: Water passes through the pan's wall; or the level jumps up with nothing added; or a second pan appears; or the pan changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pan, the burner and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or the burner's knob moves by itself; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: How quickly the boil dies down is not judged, only that it eases after the knob is turned and does not return.
